name: bulkhead
description: Hooks that stop coding agents from running shell commands that cannot be undone.

plugins.name: bulkhead
plugins.description: Blocks rm -rf and rsync --delete through an empty variable, deletes of a drive root, home or .git, link-following deletes, and pkill patterns that hit other sessions, and tells Claude the safe form. Also keeps parallel sessions from colliding on processes, ports and the git tree.
